name: Eligos
source:
He is a devil who can even sell his soul to the devil(?) to accomplish his goals of being adored.

He has a firm body and will that is unimaginable for his small body and always stands at the head of the battle to protect the other devils and block the angels.

"Right, now stroke my head, please."

"I'm cuter because I'm reliable, right?!"
